items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] But I ain't talking about him. I'm talking about old Ullett. Ullett? Ullett. Ullett, not Morett.

ctx.x: Maybe after Nam was dead. Who? Manuel.

No, he played with him then. I remember the old man, Ullett used to play, because he was the hardest man we had on the street. That was the hardest man. He started in the morning and in the evening there he was just as hard as he was. You talk about old man? I used to play that by Lispy Swole. You talk about old man Morett. Yeah, George Morett.
